Suspended Stone Shower.name: Suspended Stone Shower
Suspended Stone Shower.description: The user touches up to twenty loose stones, floats them and pushes them above a ten-meter patch before releasing by the end of their next turn. The shower deals moderate bludgeoning damage; held back, stones land across an empty escape route to block pursuit. Preparation needs reachable rubble, and the user cannot redirect stones after releasing them. Strain: heavy.
